text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that?! This is the new 
brilliance of ruin! A "speed" that even 
Fujin couldn't catch has shattered destiny 
itself!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Alas, O admirer of flowers amidst the 
storm. I am no fleeting blossom, but the 
roaring thunder across the skies! Is that 
why—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My running gave birth to a small clap of 
thunder. I see pure ambition in the eyes 
of the new vintage looking at me...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The next stage is the Takarazuka Kinen, 
where titans gather! What's about to 
begin, you ask? A clash of the colossi.
